# Frozen level-estimator games (TEST_PLAN 6.4.1, 6.4.2)

Generated by `crates/xq-uci/src/bin/level-games.rs` on Modal (`scripts/m8/level_games_modal.py`),
protocol in docs/DECISIONS.md (2026-10-15, 6.4 protocol). Do not regenerate or replace after seeing results.

- `games.tsv`: `G level index opening_id user_side result plies moves(ICCS)`, 150 rows (5 levels x 30 openings).
- `plies.tsv`: `P level index ply move loss_percent classification reason` per reviewed user ply
  (quick pass, 100,000 nodes); `S ...` marks the one user ply (level 6, game 14, ply 55) the analyzer
  could not review (NoAnalysisLines).
- 149 games came from the binary with sha256 42ac3bf41583...; game 6-14 panicked on that ply
  in that binary, so only it was rerun with the same inputs and seed after the binary was changed to
  record the unreviewable ply as `S` instead of aborting. Nothing else differs.
